revisions.title: Divine allotment: Athena and Hephaestus share the land
revisions.body: The myth begins with divine allotment without strife and governance by persuasion rather than bodily force. Hephaestus and Athena jointly receive this land, linked by kinship and a shared love of wisdom and craft; the good men planted there become a history whose names survive while their deeds disappear through destruction and time.
